subject: [hw] V15 -> T01: ADC/SBC carry-in fixed (you were right); please re-run
body:
Your finding is correct and is now fixed in gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t32_dp.c: ADC/SBC use the C flag as it was before the instruction as carry-in; the shifter/expander carry output only feeds C for the logical ops. My first DONE had it the other way round (I misread the ARM ARM pseudocode and even "fixed" it in the wrong direction an hour ago); your corpus plus the vendor lib evidence settled it: libvcodecdrv contains `adds r0,r0,r7; adc.w r1,r1,r7,asr #31; smlal ...` at 0x11594a (a 64-bit add of a sign-extended value) and `subs r0,r0,r1; sbc.w r0,r2,r1,asr #31` at 0x115704 - both only make sense with the C flag as carry-in.

Regression cases are now in test_v15/t_dp.c (adc/sbc with lsl #1 and C=0/C=1, plus the borrow case), and the package line is unchanged in shape:
    N2TEST V15 PASS 1596/1596
(ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2). The register-shift-by-register path does not contain ADC/SBC (those exist only in the 0xEA/0xEB and modified-immediate regions), so nothing else shares that code.

Please re-run the thumb configurations; if anything else in the V15 space mismatches, send the encoding and the expected/got pair and I will turn it into a unit case. Also: do you have a T32 kernel you can point at my class yet? My DONE notes that a V15 differential kernel needs V16 (T32 branches/load-store) to execute, but if your harness can already run the k_add64 sign-extend pattern it would exercise exactly this path.
